title: Prove the source-independent boundary obstruction for fixed R480 cleanup
body:
The selected R480 supplier cannot defer any of its 402 final helper climbs
through its unchanged physical FULL-frame cleanup while keeping canonical
data outputs and arbitrary source-independent helper boundary types.
The proof covers dense helper mixing, arbitrary fiber dimensions and all
batch lengths and finite recursive depths. Exact inverse-source witnesses
give the obstruction; the optimum is zero omitted climbs.

The package also classifies the larger backward target-covariance interface:
19 free operator components on 22 helpers. It checks their native ranks and
mandatory output repairs. For each paired rank-one tail, a uniform inequality
excludes a moment saving with any host of rank at most eight, even with free
scalar adapters and perfect fusion. Changed native cleanup, source-history
protocols, joint encodings and changed owners remain open.

The selected local and global profiles are unchanged, so the conditional
kappa remains 0.001672660197076918. This is a scoped mathematical obstruction,
not a new exponent or a new native construction.

Validation: the registered Python 3.12 replay passes. It checks both complete
712-coordinate scalar maps, all 402 helper witnesses, all 78 isolated
nonfinal helpers, identical directional climb events, two independent exact
covariance classifications, native frames, target projectors, owner ranks,
and eight boundary controls. Direct optimized replays also passed on
Python 3.9.6 and 3.14.7. A read-only relocated fixture passed, and altered
source bytes and certificate coefficients were rejected. No full selected
cold replay, new hosted stream, or hosted CI run is claimed.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r480-source-independent-cleanup
```

Base: bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f. Audited supplier source:
0fc329d0bec93ca7cd288eaea1295172e8789810. The new package contains the proof,
exact certificate, immutable source pins, original task card, and replay
manifest. No selected record, frozen input or upstream file changes.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in algebra,
implementation, proof review, verification and writing. Credit the retained
PR1094/PR1042 supplier lineage; Sagar Thakrar's PR1012 and PR1227; Ross
Richardson's PR1287; Scratch-net's PR1198; and the reader-contract and native
frame predecessors listed in the package. New work is Apache-2.0.
